title: BSU named after K. Karasayev and Atyrau University named after H. Dosmukhametov strengthen cooperation

blocks.text: A meeting of representatives of the Atyrau University named after K. Karasayev with the deans of the faculties of Kyrgyz Philology, Russian Philology and heads of departments of the Faculty of European Civilization was held at the Bishkek State University named after K. Karasayev. The delegation included the dean of the faculty of multilingual education Meruert Amangazieva and the head of the department of Russian philology Dzhumagalieva Uzim.

During the meeting, important issues of academic mobility of students and teaching staff, as well as the possibilities of joint supervision of PhD students were discussed. Participants discussed the prospects for publishing scientific articles and exchanging experience in the field of research.
One of the key results of the meeting was the signing of a cooperation agreement between the two universities, which opens up new horizons for joint work in the field of education and science.

This initiative is aimed at strengthening ties between universities and creating favorable conditions for the exchange of knowledge and experience, which in turn will contribute to improving the quality of education in both educational institutions.
BSU named after K. Karasayev and Atyrau University named after H. Dosmukhametov express confidence that this cooperation will become the basis for new joint projects and initiatives.
